integrity: All graph quantities generated by exact algorithms from a proven-complete list and reproduced by a different parameterization; the literature-overlap assessment is same-model and subject to inaccessible-paper and unindexed-table risks.
scientific_limitations: Only the seven-dimensional binary cube; simultaneous exchange does not require feasible intermediate subsets. Exact 240-state graph metrics are reproducible by finite certificates.
title: The half-exchange graph of minimum dominating sets of the seven-cube
